instruction.text: Match the sentences to the measurements they are describing.

atoms.a: Leah buys half a kilogram of apples.
The train was delayed by a quarter of an hour.
Jenny gets £20 for pocket money. She has already spent half of it.
There are 30 students in the class. One third of them are boys.
The apple tree has grown half a metre in the last month.
My parents are celebrating their silver wedding anniversary. They have now been married for a quarter of a century.
Anton’s route to school is one and a half kilometres long.
School ends in three-quarters of an hour.

instruction.text: Match the sentences to the measurements they are describing.

atoms.a: You should drink 2 and a half litres of water a day.
My parents are two and a half decades older than me.
I gave my sister £36 for her birthday. She has only spent one third of it so far.
Jake will be an hour and one third late to the party.
Erica is a quarter of a metre taller than her little brother.
The children ran half a kilometre on sports day.
Anya’s school bag weighs one and a quarter kilograms.
It will be midnight in a quarter of an hour.
